title: Update to Grid Grind - How it's going
author: t0fus0up
selftext:
Quick overview  
\- The entire code base was generated through Cursor Ai with Composer and Claude using the $60 Cursor plan.  The initial prototype used Gemini Canvas  
\- I use Gemini Canvas for all my game prototypes, vfx, UI....prior to taking it into Cursor  
\- All the 3d assets, vfx are generated by code using simple shapes, and shaders found online with MIT licenses  
\- The music and SFX came from the Unity asset store that I paid for  
\- The only art I got was from my friend for the logo and steam capsule art  
\- The game took a few days to prototype, and about 2+ months of polish to get to this point  
\- Right now I can build to iOS, itch, and steam  
\- Steam using NW.js steamworks.js, iOS using capacitor.  All custom JS + Three.js.  Basically a WebGL game

comments.author: AMadHammer
comments.body: What is your personal goal with this game?

replies.author: t0fus0up
replies.body: Learning ai workflow to work on bigger games.  My goal was to start small, so I can learn to finish.  Next project I'm looking into use Godot and MCP.  If this can bring in some pocket change, I'll be very pleased.
